journey.name: Bottom navigation
journey.description: Launches the app and switches through every bottom-bar tab, verifying that each destination screen is shown. Start state: fresh install (app opens on the Wardrobe tab).

actions.action: Verify the app is on the Wardrobe screen: the bottom navigation bar is visible with the WARDROBE tab selected, and the "Your wardrobe" heading is shown.
Tap the "OUTFITS" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify the Outfits screen is shown with the "Your outfits" heading.
Tap the "GAPS" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify the Gaps screen is shown with the "What's missing" heading.
Tap the "TRY IT" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify the Try It screen is shown (either the "Would it fit your wardrobe?" heading or the "AI powered analysis" locked state is visible).
Tap the "SETTINGS" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify the Settings screen is shown with the "Settings" heading and a "Claude API Key" row.
Tap the "WARDROBE" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify the app has returned to the Wardrobe screen.
